name: Individuality
overview: Scripture reveals that individuality is divinely ordained and intimately known by God from the very beginning of life, as He forms each person uniquely in the womb (Psalms 139:13; Jeremiah 1:5). God's care extends to even the smallest details, such as numbering the hairs on our heads, demonstrating our great value to Him (Matthew 10:30; Luke 12:7). While God's thoughts and ways transcend human understanding (Isaiah 55:8), He calls each believer to a personal commitment of self-denial and daily surrender in following Christ (Luke 9:23), highlighting the tension between our unique identity and the call to live in obedience to Him.
